assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animated VFX sprite atlas for a premium arcade martial arts game. EXACT 6 columns x 4 rows = 24 equal square cells in a wide 3:2 image. Every effect isolated on ACTUAL transparent background, no black backdrop, no text, no grid lines, NO character. Same effect center and size per cell. Row1 six temporal frames of a fiery red-orange fist impact: tiny ignition, narrow sharp star burst, expanding white-hot orange impact, outward sparks, fading ember ring, scattered fading sparks. Row2 same six temporal frames of electric turquoise lightning impact. Row3 same six temporal frames of golden stone-shattering shockwave impact with fine dust sparks. Row4 same six temporal frames of violet crescent slash with silver sharp sparks. Stylized realistic 3D fighting game effects with luminous particles and crisp hot white core. Keep all bursts fully inside each cell with generous padding. These must be actual consecutive animation frames that expand and then dissipate, not six identical explosions. No smoke backdrop or rectangular color gradients. High detail, physically dynamic energy shapes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production reaction sprite atlas matching the EXACT FOUR CHARACTERS in the four reference atlases. Reference 1 red male boxer Taeo, reference 2 cyan female taekwondo Seorin, reference 3 gold male heavyweight Mujin, reference 4 silver-haired violet female Yura. EXACT 6 columns and 4 rows in landscape 3:2, 24 separate square cells. Row1 Taeo; Row2 Seorin; Row3 Mujin; Row4 Yura. Each row's six consecutive poses left to right: 1 standing tight forearm guard; 2 braced lower guard with knees bent; 3 torso recoiling backward from punch impact, feet on ground; 4 recovering from that recoil; 5 low crouched super-power charging stance; 6 forward lunge explosive launch stance. Full body, same consistent body scale and foot baseline at 90% cell height, facing RIGHT, all limbs INSIDE own cell, generous transparent padding. Preserve exact character faces, outfits, hair, proportions and 3D render look of references. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background, ZERO backdrop, ZERO gradients, NO glow, NO floor, NO shadows, NO text, no grid lines, no effects or particles. Only fighter silhouettes. Anatomically correct, clean studio lighting.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW premium character selection portrait atlas for these EXACT four original fighters from the four reference images. A wide 2:1 image consisting of four equally sized tall vertical portrait panels with NO gutters, no text, no logos, no borders, no UI. One waist-up portrait per panel: left to right Taeo red sleeveless jacket Korean male boxer short black hair white hand wraps; Seorin cyan cropped athletic jacket Korean female high dark ponytail; Mujin gold hooded sleeveless vest mature Korean male heavyweight dark cropped hair neat beard black-gold boxing gloves; Yura silver-white short bob Korean female violet martial jacket. Expressive determined faces, precise realistic 3D game character render, dramatic rim lights matching each costume color, rich textures, heroic eyes looking towards camera, hands in loose ready guard. Same framing scale, heads fully visible with 10% space above. Background each panel deep charcoal with restrained colored smoke, cinematic polished fighting game key art. Keep identities identical to references.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make a NEW detailed temporal attack animation atlas of the EXACT fighter in the reference. Preserve their identical face, outfit, proportions and polished 3D render. EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 6 ROWS =24 equal square frames in a vertical 2:3 image, clean ACTUAL alpha transparent background. Fixed side view, facing RIGHT, fixed body scale and grounded foot baseline at 88% cell height; all limbs must fully fit INSIDE their own cell with generous padding. First TWELVE cells (top 3 rows, read left to right) show ONE COMPLETE smooth straight rear-hand power punch cycle in 12 consecutive temporal steps: guard, weight shift, shoulder load, elbow launch, half extension, near extension, full-contact extension, slight follow-through, elbow recoil, torso unwinding, resetting arm, return to guard. Last TWELVE cells (bottom 3 rows) show ONE COMPLETE smooth high turning kick cycle in 12 temporal steps: guard, weight load, foot pivot, hip twist, knee raise, half extension, full-contact extension, extended follow-through, folding knee, lowering leg, resetting stance, return to guard. Adjacent frames must have SMALL gradual motion differences. These are actual sequential animation cels, NOT 24 different attacks. Avoid changes in camera angle, body scale or anatomy. Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation atlas for a premium 2.5D side-view arcade martial arts fighting game. EXACTLY 6 columns and 4 rows = 24 frames in a wide 3:2 image. Each cell is square, occupies exactly 1/6 width and 1/4 height, with NO grid lines or text. Transparent background with actual alpha. A single identical original fighter repeated in all 24 cells, full body facing RIGHT with fixed side-view camera, CONSISTENT BODY SCALE and grounded foot baseline at 84% of every cell. Every silhouette including a completely extended kick MUST fit inside its own cell with 10% empty padding. The fighter should occupy only 60% of cell height so extended limbs do not leave their cell. Root/hips centered horizontally at 42% of each cell. High-quality crisp 3D game render with realistic athletic anatomy, cloth detail, clean cutout silhouette and soft frontal studio lighting. NO shadows, NO glow, NO backdrop, NO panel borders, NO numbers. Animation instructions: ROW 1: six consecutive frames of a smooth loop of breathing fighting stance, gently shifting weight and gloves, starting and ending with compatible poses. ROW 2: six consecutive walking-forward gait cycle frames, alternating planted and lifted feet, slight body bob, stance maintained. ROW 3: six consecutive frames of a powerful straight-punch combo: anticipation, lead jab extension, jab recovery and hip twist, rear cross extension, cross recovery, return to guard. ROW 4: six consecutive frames of a powerful turning high kick: crouched load, pivoting windup, knee lift, full leg extension, recoil knee, return to guard. This must be a temporal animation sequence, NOT 24 unrelated dramatic poses. Anatomically correct arms and legs. Never duplicate or overlap a limb across cell boundaries. Render at the largest available landscape resolution for detailed game sprites.
